description: Copy one ad squad (optionally with its ads) into a target campaign. Created PAUSED. Budgets are scaled by budget_scale and must stay within the configured limits. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token. Use to duplicate one ad squad (PAUSED), optionally into another campaign. Not for a whole campaign (snap_copy_campaign).

adsquad_id.description: Ad squad id. Get it from snap_list_adsquads.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

budget_scale.description: Multiplier for the copied daily budgets, for example 0.5 for half.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

include_ads.description: true = copy the ads too (they start PAUSED).

new_name.description: Name for the copy or the new name for the item.

target_campaign_id.description: Id of the campaign that receives the copy. Get it from snap_list_campaigns.

name: snap_copy_adsquad
